title: Cabot Trail - La Bloc Beach Coastal Erosion Protection
summary: Project by Parks Canada in Nova Scotia. The notice mentions shoreline protection work.
quotes: Construction activities generally include excavation and grading of the highway embankment, installation of a rock revetment using armourstone, filterstone, and clearstone and extension of four drainage culverts through the revetment.
Following construction, excavated beach material will be reinstated over and along the sides of the revetment to help integrate the structure into the surrounding landscape.
The project involves coastal erosion protection along a vulnerable section of the Cabot Trail, La Bloc Beach, within Cape Breton Highlands National Park.
agency: Impact Assessment Agency of Canada, Canadian Impact Assessment Registry
